# rasuvaeff/retry

Closure-first retry with fixed/exponential backoff, jitter, time budgets, fake
clock/sleeper/randomizer for tests, hooks, and a PSR-18 decorator that honors
`Retry-After`.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/retry
```

## Rules

- Namespace: `Rasuvaeff\Retry`.
- Use `FakeSleeper` and `FakeClock` in tests; never wait on real sleeps or
  wall-clock time.
- `Retry::run()` returns the closure value or throws `RetryExhausted`.
  Non-retryable exceptions are rethrown as-is; only retryable failures that run
  out of attempts or budget are wrapped.
- Default retry triggers on any `\Exception`. `\Error` is NOT retried; opt in
  with `retryOn(\Error::class)`. `retryOn()` REPLACES the class list (lets you
  narrow the default); `retryIf()`/`stopIf()` layer extra predicates.
- `retryIfResult(fn(mixed): bool)` retries when the operation returns an
  unacceptable value (no throw needed). On exhaustion `RetryExhausted::lastException`
  is an `UnacceptableResult` whose `$result` holds the rejected value.
- `RetryExhausted` exposes `attempts`, `lastException`, `history`, and `reason`
  (`ExhaustionReason::MaxAttempts` or `ExhaustionReason::TimeBudget`).
- Each `AttemptRecord` in `history` carries `attempt`, `delayMs` (null on the
  terminal record), `elapsedMs`, and `exception`; `delay(): ?Duration` and
  `elapsed(): Duration` expose the same values as `rasuvaeff/duration` objects
  (same on `Http\HttpAttemptRecord`).
- Duration-typed counterparts of the `int`-ms API (additive, `int` API
  unchanged): `Retry::fixedFor(Duration)`, `Retry::exponentialFor(Duration $base,
  Duration $cap)`, `withFixedFor()`, `withExponentialFor()`, `stopAfter(Duration)`,
  and `RetryPolicy::fixedFor()` / `RetryPolicy::exponentialFor()`.
- This package has no Result dependency. Wrap `run()` with
  `Result::fromThrowable()` (or equivalent) to get a typed result value instead
  of an exception.
- Named factories: `Retry::fixed()`, `Retry::exponential()`, `Retry::immediate()`.
- Tune a builder with `withFixed()`, `withExponential()`, `withImmediate()`,
  `withClock()`. No magic methods.
- `stopAfterMs(int)` caps total wall-clock time: attempt 1 always runs, a
  follow-up is skipped when `elapsed + nextDelay` would exceed the budget.
- Clock uses PSR-20 (`Psr\Clock\ClockInterface`); no custom clock abstraction.
- `Retry::onRetry` callbacks receive an `AttemptRecord`; `Retry::onExhausted`
  callbacks receive the `RetryExhausted` exception (no positional args).
- `jitter(float $factor, JitterMode $mode)` takes a `Jitter\JitterMode` enum
  (`Additive`/`Full`/`None`), not a string; `factor` applies only to `Additive`.
  `Additive` is equal jitter (spreads downward only), so `capMs` stays a hard
  ceiling.
- `Http\RetryingHttpClient`: `retryOnResponse`/`retryOnException` both receive
  `RequestInterface` as the 2nd arg (gate on method/idempotency). Use
  `Http\RetryDecisions` for ready-made predicates and
  `RetryDecisions::onlyIdempotent($inner)` to retry only GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE/
  OPTIONS/TRACE. `respectRetryAfter` honors `Retry-After` capped by
  `maxRetryAfterMs` (default 300000, null disables); `budgetMs` caps total time;
  `retryOnException` filters transport exceptions (null = retry all);
  `onRetry` callbacks take `Http\HttpAttemptRecord`, `onExhausted` callbacks take
  `Http\HttpRetryExhausted` (carries `attempts` + `history`); `onExhausted` fires
  on every exhaustion. With `throwOnExhausted: true` that same
  `Http\HttpRetryExhausted` (implements `ClientExceptionInterface`) is thrown
  instead of returning the last response. A seekable request body is rewound
  before every re-send (PSR-7 streams are stateful); requests with a
  non-seekable body are NOT safely retryable — the body cannot be replayed.
  Unusable `Retry-After` values (oversized delta-seconds, dates that don't
  round-trip IMF-fixdate exactly) are ignored and fall back to backoff.

## API reference

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\AttemptRecord;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Clock\SystemClock;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Jitter\JitterMode;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Retry;

$value = Retry::new()
    ->maxAttempts(3)
    ->withExponential(baseMs: 100, multiplier: 2.0, capMs: 30_000)
    ->jitter(factor: 0.2, mode: JitterMode::Additive)
    ->retryOn(RuntimeException::class)
    ->retryIf(fn(Throwable $e): bool => $e->getCode() >= 500)
    ->stopIf(fn(Throwable $e): bool => $e instanceof InvalidArgumentException)
    ->retryIfResult(fn(mixed $r): bool => $r === null) // retry on a bad return value
    ->stopAfterMs(budgetMs: 10_000)
    ->withClock(new SystemClock())
    ->onRetry(fn(AttemptRecord $record) => null)
    ->run(fn(): string => flakyOperation());
```

Core types: `Retry`, `RetryPolicy`, `RetryPolicyInterface`, `RetryExhausted`,
`ExhaustionReason`, `AttemptRecord`, `UnacceptableResult`.

Backoff: `BackoffStrategy\BackoffStrategyInterface`, `FixedBackoff`,
`ExponentialBackoff`, `ImmediateBackoff`.

Jitter: `Jitter\JitterInterface`, `JitterMode` (enum), `FullJitter`,
`AdditiveJitter`, `NoJitter`.

Clock (PSR-20): `Clock\SystemClock`, `Clock\FakeClock` (mutable, `advanceMs()`).

Testability: `Sleeper\SleeperInterface`, `SystemSleeper`, `FakeSleeper`,
`Randomizer\RandomizerInterface`, `SystemRandomizer`, `FixedRandomizer`.

HTTP: `Http\RetryingHttpClient` (PSR-18 decorator with `Retry-After` support),
`Http\RetryDecisions` (ready-made predicates + `onlyIdempotent()`),
`Http\HttpAttemptRecord`, `Http\HttpRetryExhausted`, `Http\RetryAfterParser`.

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Http\HttpAttemptRecord;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Http\HttpRetryExhausted;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Http\RetryDecisions;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Http\RetryingHttpClient;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\RetryPolicy;

$client = new RetryingHttpClient(
    inner: $psr18Client,
    policy: RetryPolicy::exponential(maxAttempts: 3, baseMs: 100),
    retryOnResponse: RetryDecisions::onlyIdempotent(RetryDecisions::transient()),
    respectRetryAfter: true,    // honor Retry-After header
    maxRetryAfterMs: 300_000,   // cap server delay; null disables
    budgetMs: null,             // total wall-clock budget; null disables
    retryOnException: null,     // fn(ClientExceptionInterface, RequestInterface): bool; null = retry all
    throwOnExhausted: false,    // true -> throw Http\HttpRetryExhausted with history
    onRetry: [fn(HttpAttemptRecord $r): null => null],
    onExhausted: [fn(HttpRetryExhausted $exhausted): null => null], // ->attempts, ->history
    // clock defaults to Clock\SystemClock; pass Clock\FakeClock in tests
);
```
